properties.accuracyNote: The Freedom West lots on the two blocks the Planning Department's project page describes (bounded by Gough Street, Golden Gate Avenue, Laguna Street and Fulton Street, bisected by McAllister Street; a 10.37-acre site). No official lot list was reachable; the lots are those carrying the project's addresses in the Planning records (710 and 867 McAllister Street; 0770/027) and the rest of the block south of McAllister. Lot 0770/027 also holds the adjacent 880 McAllister Street senior housing site, a separate project, which is drawn inside. 10.8 acres as drawn.
